title: TEMPER: Temporal Encoder-Masked Probabilistic Ensemble Regressor for Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.23701v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting requires accurate central predictions and calibrated uncertainty estimates. This paper presents TEMPER, the Temporal Encoder-Masked Probabilistic Ensemble Regressor, a univariate time-series forecasting algorithm that combines a temporal autoencoder, a differentiable masked neural decision forest, continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) training, and Gaussian-mixture post-processing. The R implementation is built on torch for R and returns horizon-wise density, distribution, quantile, and sampler functions. We evaluate TEMPER on three deterministic synthetic level series with trend, periodic, regime-switching, nonlinear-threshold, and heteroskedastic components. Across 96 rolling-origin forecasts at horizons t + 1, t + 5, t + 20, and t + 60, TEMPER obtains 2.824% mean CRPS normalized by origin level, 3.635% median absolute error, and 68.8% empirical 90% interval coverage after training with a 300-epoch cap

translated_title: TEMPER：用于时间序列预测的时序编码器-掩码概率集成回归器
translated_abstract: 概率预测需要准确的核心预测以及经过校准的不确定性估计。本文提出了TEMPER（时序编码器-掩码概率集成回归器），这是一种单变量时间序列预测算法，它结合了时序自编码器、可微分掩码神经决策森林、连续排序概率评分（CRPS）训练以及高斯混合后处理。其R语言实现基于torch for R构建，可返回按预测步长划分的密度函数、分布函数、分位数函数和采样器函数。我们在三个包含趋势、周期、状态切换、非线性阈值和异方差成分的确定性合成水平序列上对TEMPER进行了评估。在预测步长为t+1、t+5、t+20和t+60的96次滚动起点预测中，经过最多300轮训练后，TEMPER获得了以起点水平归一化的2.824%平均CRPS、3.635%的中位绝对误差以及68.8%的90%经验区间覆盖率。
tldr: TEMPER是一种将时序自编码器、可微分掩码神经决策森林、CRPS训练与高斯混合后处理相结合的单变量时间序列概率预测算法，能够在多个预测步长上同时实现准确的核心预测和校准的不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: TEMPER is a univariate probabilistic time-series forecasting algorithm that combines a temporal autoencoder, a differentiable masked neural decision forest, CRPS training, and Gaussian-mixture post-processing to deliver accurate central predictions with calibrated uncertainty estimates across multiple forecast horizons.
